cards.canonical_statement: For P,Q continuous on an ordered planar rectangle, assume specified derivatives outside a countable interior exception set, integrable scalar curl, and constant curl c throughout the closed rectangle. Then the counterclockwise boundary line integral of P dx+Q dy equals c times the rectangle area. Individual side integrals need not be known and the field need not be a gradient.
cards.proof_strategy: Apply the weak Green theorem, retaining closed-boundary continuity, countable derivative exceptions, and curl integrability.
sketch_steps: Apply the weak Green theorem, retaining closed-boundary continuity, countable derivative exceptions, and curl integrability.
Replace the area-integral integrand by c using the equality on the entire rectangle.
Identify the rectangle as a product of its two closed coordinate intervals.
Compute its Lebesgue measure as the product of the two nonnegative side lengths.
Convert the constant area integral to c times this area, preserving counterclockwise boundary orientation.

 (((∫ x in a.1..b.1, P (x,a.2)) + (∫ y in a.2..b.2, Q (b.1,y))) - (∫ x in a.1..b.1, P (x,b.2))) - (∫ y in a.2..b.2, Q (a.1,y)) = c*(b.1-a.1)*(b.2-a.2)
